public_input.query: Elena and Marcus are visiting London for a romantic 3-day Easter weekend (Saturday April 4th to Monday April 6th). As a couple who loves art and photography, they want to spend their time exploring museums and capturing the city's beauty. Elena is a vegetarian, so they need to ensure their meals have meat-free options. They're also not fans of the busiest crowds and would much prefer to avoid the most high-traffic tourist hotspots, opting for the city's quieter gems instead. Can you plan an itinerary that includes at least two museum visits and makes sure they can find great photo opportunities every day? They also want a special meal on Easter Sunday.

personal_constraints.description: At least 60% of meals must be at venues with vegetarian-options tag.

personal_constraints.source_in_profile: avoid the most high-traffic tourist hotspots
personal_constraints.description: No more than 25% of activities in the plan should be at high-traffic venues.
The plan must include at least two visits to museum-category venues.
At least one activity per day must be at a venue with an 'instagrammable' or 'architecture-city-skyline' or 'views' tag.
